[GregFiona] Favorite setting
Your Airfryer comes with a save favorite setting mode. You select your
favorite cooking temperature and time, then press and hold the save
favorite button. You will hear a beep after the setting is saved. If you want
to change your favorite setting, do the previous steps again.

[Marty131] Agreed - I’d rather pay the extra $9 at Amazon for delivery and an easier warranty.
[huntabargain] DJ free delivery over $100, warranty by manufacture anyway.
[Maker1] But in that case it's much more inconvenient and time consuming and you are strictly limited to claiming the warranty within the warranty period. After that expires, you can only seek a damages or compensation order which might not cover 100% of the purchase price due to wear and tear and depreciation.
If you go for the retailer, you can always argue that you are entitled to a choice of remedy regardless of a manufacturer's warranty period, because you have a direct contract with them.
So if a retailer is going broke, such as David Jones, then they might not be around to provide a remedy later. The extra $9 is thus a lot cheaper than the amount of time and stress you will spend trying to claim against a manufacturer.
[DevGuy] @Maker1: Assuming it fails outside of Amazon’s return window, you’ll need to make a warranty claim with the manufacturer.
[t25] assuming they send it before the administrators shuts it for good
